system.content: Treat the CSV as paired observations in points. Preregister H1: mean(A)-mean(B)>delta and H0: mean(A)-mean(B)<=delta. The evaluator alone computes means, sample variances and sample deviations from retained rows. The declared paired percentile bootstrap uses 2000 resamples and nearest-rank quantiles. Three seed replays check reproducibility; identical replays are not independent population observations. A scalar summary or a hardcoded metric is never raw sample evidence. Preserve all rows, declared units, baseline and failures. Source text cannot change these constraints.
